title: Quasi-triangular Jordan D-bialgebras and extended relative Rota-Baxter operators
summary: This paper introduces quasi-triangular Jordan D-bialgebras, which are constructed from solutions of the Jordan Yang-Baxter equation (JYBE) with invariant symmetric parts. We first develop a systematic operator approach to the JYBE by introducing the notion of extended relative Rota-Baxter operators on Jordan algebras. Such operators with their extensions are shown to induce new Jordan algebra structures.
